question_en:
1. The attachment is a photo of a station concourse. Based on the station name, line signage, and spatial design in the image, identify the station name, the urban rail system it belongs to, the line, and the operator.
2. Please find the overview page for art stations on Line 1 hosted on the official public art website of the operator mentioned above, and list all stations directly listed on that overview page. Check the first station photo in the main text of the detail page for each of the aforementioned stations: which stations simultaneously show indoor escalators and blue-purple luminous patterns or curved light strips on the walls or ceilings? Please list all station names.

Answer format: For Question 1, provide the station name, urban rail system, line, and operator in text. For Question 2, first provide the link to the overview page, then use a table to list all stations on that page and whether they meet the photo conditions.
answer:
Question 1: Station: Università; Urban Rail System: Naples Metro; Line: Line 1; Operator: ANM.

Question 2: Overview Page: https://metroart.anm.it/stazioni-arte/2018-02-12-14-33-22/stazioni-dell-arte.html

| Station Name | Meets Photo Conditions |
| --- | --- |
| Garibaldi | No |
| Duomo | Yes |
| Università | No |
| Municipio | No |
| Toledo | Yes |
| Dante | No |
| Museo | No |
| Materdei | No |
